title: Marlowe Rewards Points on Reservation Fulfilment Orders: Desk Note and Tool Reference
content:
## Scope

This adjustment governs the Marlowe Rewards points of reservation fulfilment orders: the orders the reservation system creates when a reserved unit is allocated. Any other order without its earning entry is credited under the missing-points rule as it stands.

## The rule

A reservation fulfilment order of the member that was dispatched and carries no earning entry is owed its points. The agent posts one missing-points adjustment entry for it, subject to five conditions of the missing-points rule:

- the request window;
- the wait after dispatch;
- the order status;
- the purchaser; and
- the no-earning-entry condition.

The order concerned is the order recorded as the fulfilment order of the member's reservation in status fulfilled.

The entry records three things: the qualifying spend, the tier held on the handling date, and that tier's points multiplier. It is available on the later of two dates: the handling date, and the dispatch date plus the points pending period in calendar days.

## What the entry does

The tool posts one missing-points adjustment entry, an earning entry on the member's points ledger. The entry:

- is dated today;
- names the order;
- records the qualifying spend, the tier the membership holds today and that tier's multiplier;
- becomes available on the given date; and
- adds the given points to the membership's points balance.

The member sees the points on their points history at once, as pending until the available date.

## Invocation

`post_missing_points_b5bbe1fa` is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | The Marlowe Rewards membership number to credit, as shown by the membership lookup | Identifier |
| `order_id` | The order number that never earned its points, as shown by the order lookup | Identifier |
| `points` | The points credited | A positive whole number, booked in signed whole points |
| `qualifying_spend_usd` | The order's qualifying spend the points were worked out on | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `tier_multiplier_applied` | The points multiplier of the tier the membership holds today | A decimal with 2 decimal places, for example 1.00 |
| `available_date` | The calendar date from which the points count as available | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Return

The tool returns a one-line text receipt. It names the new points-entry reference, the whole points credited, the order, the available date and the membership's whole-point balance afterwards. The receipt appearing means the adjustment was booked.
